actions.createOrUpdateContact.descriptio: Create a new contact or update an existing contact by phone number
actions.createOrUpdateContact.props.cont: Contact ID for updating an existing contact. If not provided, will attempt to create a new contact
actions.createOrUpdateContact.props.is_o: Whether the contact is opted out of messaging
actions.createOrUpdateContact.props.over: When true, replaces all existing custom fields. When false, merges with existing ones. Note: contact name is always overwritten
actions.createOrUpdateContact.props.phon: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434)
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.sendCustomMessage.description: Send a custom text message to an individual contact or a list
actions.sendCustomMessage.props.creator_: Unique identifier for the sender (member ID from Get Inboxes)
actions.sendCustomMessage.props.inbox_id: Unique identifier for the inbox from which the message will be sent
actions.sendCustomMessage.props.phone_nu: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434). Required if not sending to a list or chat
Array of phone numbers in E.164 format without the plus sign for group MMS messages
actions.sendTemplateMessage.description: Send a message using a template to an individual contact or a list
actions.sendTemplateMessage.props.creato: Unique identifier for the sender (member ID from Get Inboxes)
actions.sendTemplateMessage.props.inbox_: Unique identifier for the inbox from which the message will be sent
actions.sendTemplateMessage.props.phone_: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434). Required if not sending to a list
actions.sendTemplateMessage.props.target: Array of phone numbers in E.164 format without the plus sign for group MMS messages
actions.sendTemplateMessage.props.templa: Unique identifier for the Heymarket template to send
actions.sendTemplateMessage.props.text.d: Optional message text body to override or supplement the template
actions.updateList.description: Update an existing list in your team by adding or removing members, or updating list properties
actions.updateList.props.add_phone.descr: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign to add to the list (e.g. 14155553434)
actions.updateList.props.list_id.descrip: Unique identifier for the list to update
actions.updateList.props.members.descrip: Object of list targets. Keys are phone numbers, values are objects with optional first name (f) and last name (l)
actions.updateList.props.remove_phone.de: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign to remove from the list (e.g. 14155553434)

description: Heymarket is a business texting platform that gives you the power to engage with people using shared inboxes.
triggers.chatStarted.description: Trigger when a new conversation is started or an existing conversation is updated
triggers.chatStarted.props.inboxId.descr: The Heymarket inbox IDs to monitor for new conversations
triggers.chatStarted.props.userId.descri: The Heymarket user ID for verification. This is the ID of a team member who has access to the inboxes.
triggers.newOrUpdatedContact.description: Trigger when a new contact is created or an existing contact is updated
